CustomField.description: The dollar amount of this single charge component. Rolls up into the bill total, so the components always reconcile to the invoice. ARCHITECTURE section 1 forbids a bare Fee or Cost name; the Amount suffix marks it as a total in dollars.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the amount for this component only, not the invoice total, and enter credits as a negative number so the bill total still reconciles.
CustomField.label: Charge Amount
